messages.subject: Data formatting for HCM
parts:
Hi all,

I have a question regarding formatting for hierarchical Bayesian community models (Kery and Royle, Ch. 11), particularly on how to get R to ready my 3D matrix correctly. I have tried everything, including following the code in the book. The example code manipulates the data in R, and I cannot seem to replicate.

I have created the 3 .csv files and am attempting to get to this line of code:

library(jagsUI)
library(AHMbook)
data(MHB2014)
data<-data(MHB2014)
data
MHB2014$sites
MHB2014$species
df<-MHB2014$count
dim(MHB2014$count)

# Check the detection data in 3D array MHB2014$count: site x rep x species
( nsite <- nrow(MHB2014$sites) )    # number of sites in Swiss MHB
nrep <- 3                           # maximum number of replicate surveys per season
( nspec <- nrow(MHB2014$species) )  # 158 species occur in the 2014 data
dim(MHB2014$count) == c(nsite, nrep, nspec) # check

# Create the detection/nondetection (1/0) array
y <- MHB2014$count ; y[y > 1] <- 1  ## 'Y' replaced with 'y'
str(y)
y

# Check data for one species, here chaffinch, and pull them out from 3D array
(tmp <- y[, , "ANPA"])

Can anyone please help me? 

Thank You,

Sarah

messages.author: 4a15de51da4445ae
messages.subject: Re: Data formatting for HCM
parts:
hi Sarah, this bit of code works for your data set, which I interpret to have 5 sites, 4 reps and 26 species, unless I'm missing something there.
regards
andy


x<-read.csv("counts_HME.csv")
nam<- colnames(x)

y2d<- x[,-1]
nspec<- 26
idx<- sort(rep(1:26,4))
y3d<- array(NA,dim=c(5,4,26))  # nsites x nreps x nspec
for(i in 1:26){
y3d[1:5,1:4,i]<- as.matrix(y2d[,idx==i] )
}
